contact1.title: Get in Touch
contact1.subtitle: Have questions or interested in partnering with us? We'd love to hear from you!

contact_faq.a: You can reach us through the contact form above, by email, or through our mobile app's support feature.
We currently operate in major cities across Syria. Check our app for specific coverage in your area.

contact_faq.q: How quickly can I get help?
contact_faq.a: Our average response time is under 30 minutes in covered areas, depending on your location and traffic conditions.
Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption and never store your complete payment details.

contact_faq.q: Can I schedule services in advance?
contact_faq.a: Yes! You can book scheduled maintenance or services through our app at your convenience.

contact_faq.q: Do I request service from the website or the app?
contact_faq.a: The website explains the service and handles provider registration. Requesting and tracking a service happen in the app.

contact_faq.q: How is the provider who reaches me chosen?
contact_faq.a: The request is routed to a provider near your location, available at the time of the request, who offers the service you selected.

contact_faq.q: How do I register my workshop or service as a provider?
contact_faq.a: Use the “Join as Provider” button at the top of the site. You fill in your business details, services, and working hours, then the data is reviewed before you start receiving requests.
